proposals.evidence: Turner truṭyati explicitly gives Lahnda truṭaṇ and ṭuṭṭaṇ break, Punjabi taruṭṭṇā and broken-state participles. The Awan broken response trotī preserves the diagnostic tr- of that western verb family with an ordinary feminine past ending.
